title: Thanjavur Dancing Doll
tagline: Tune, tap and settle the nodding clay dolls.
description: Thanjavur Dancing Doll turns the famous weighted folk toy of southern India into a balance and rhythm game. Slide each doll's bead to tune its swing, tap to keep it nodding, and match a ghost doll's sway before settling every doll upright. 24 levels, a daily set, painted-doll collection, Practice, Watch and Learn, an in-app Rules book, portrait and landscape play, synthesised sound, no ads.
howToPlay: Slide a doll's bead until its swing time matches the tag.
Tap a doll on the side it is leaving to keep it swinging; near the rim is a firm push.
Stay inside the ghost doll during the Hold part to score.
Rest a finger on a doll to steady it, and settle them upright at the end.
Earn stars to paint the clay dolls: body, face, then gold trim.
Watch and Learn tunes and plays the level for you and thinks before each part. Pause it any time.
On a keyboard: 1-3 pick a doll, Left and Right push, Up and Down move the bead, Space starts.
